content:
[Intro]
[Dm]

[Verse 1]
[Dm]Three thirty in the mornin',
[Bb]not a soul in sight
[A7]The city's lookin' like a ghost town on a
moonless summer night [Dm]
Raindrops on the windshield, there's a storm
[Bb]movin' in
[A7]He's headin' back from somewhere that he
never should have been [Dm]
And the thunder rolls
[C]
[A7]And the thunder rolls
[Dm]

[Verse 2]
[Dm]Every light is burnin' in a
[Bb]house across town
[A7]She's pacin' by the telephone in her
faded flannel gown [Dm]
Askin' for a miracle,
[Bb]hopin' she's not right
[A7]Prayin' it's the weather that's
kept him out all night
[Dm]And the thunder rolls
[C]
[A7]And the thunder rolls
[Dm]The thunder

[Chorus]
[Bb]rolls, [C]and the lightnin'
[Dm]strikes Another love grows
[Bb]cold [C]on a sleepless
[A7]night As the storm blows
[Bb]on [C]out of control
[Dm]Deep in her heart
[Bb][C]the thunder

[Interlude]
[Dm]rolls

[Verse 3]
[Dm]She's waitin' by the window when he
[Bb]pulls into the drive
[A7]She rushes out to hold him,
thankful he's alive [Dm]
But on the wind and rain a strange
[Bb]new perfume blows And the
[A7]lightnin' flashes in her eyes, and
he knows that she knows
[Dm]And the thunder rolls
[C]
[A7]And the thunder rolls
[Dm]
The thunder

[Chorus]
[Bb]rolls, [C]and the lightnin'
[Dm]strikes Another love grows
[Bb]cold [C]on a sleepless
[A7]night As the storm blows
[Bb]on [C]out of control
[Dm]Deep in her heart
[Bb][C]the thunder

[Outro]
[Dm]rolls

[Fade Out]
title: The Thunder Rolls
tuning: E A D G B E
